title: RiverHaven 6
description:
Short Term Rental Permit #: 20170817   RiverHaven is located on the Cumberland River and offers comfort and peace after a day in Nashville. Nestled in a quiet neighborhood, you would never know you're only 18 minutes (8.4 miles) from downtown and ten minutes from Gaylord Opryland. RiverHaven is my home and I stay in an attached studio room with separate kitchen, bathroom and bed.

The space
You will have three bedrooms and two baths, living room and dining room. Also included is the kitchen with dishes, silverware and cookware. Patio overlooks the river and there are several options for seating and viewing the Cumberland.

Other things to note
There is a cat named Prince that is outside during the day and inside my area at night. He is not in the house where guests stay.

I enjoy my family, walking, good books, the beach and singing in the choir. I am a retired teacher in the Nashville Public School System. Broadway musicals are one of my favorite things to see. The peace of the river has been a haven to me and my family. We call our home built in 1926, RiverHaven. My life saying is seek peace and pursue it.
